name: phpfixes
description: Check supplied PHP build evidence for PHP2Shell fixes and compare local PHP package versions with running workers.

interface.longDescription: Check supplied PHP2Shell build records through declared local tools. Compare PHP packages and running workers without inferring a fix from installed files. Local Linux inventory requires a direct request. Python 3.9+ and a local execution host are required.
defaultPrompt: Check this PHP build for PHP2Shell fixes.
Compare these PHP packages with running workers.
Show missing evidence in this local PHP inventory.
